scientific_invariants: Frozen protocol, schedule, candidates, seeds, horizons, controller, encoder, outcome contract and audits unchanged.

Each (method, seed) lane runs its blocks in frozen order with the frozen dispatch permutation; PPO triplets and successive updates stay sequential.
No future-panel, validation or reserved outcome informs any earlier block.
Lane priority changes dispatch order only.
